title: TD Synnex to acquire specialty distributor BlueStar
description:
TD Synnex, one of the world’s largest technology distributors, announced that it signed a definitive agreement to acquire Clearwater, Florida-based BlueStar. BlueStar is a specialty distributor of barcode scanners, point-of-sale systems, RFID, robotics and other business technology. The deal, which still needs regulatory approval, gives TD Synnex deeper domain knowledge in a niche corner of […]
